latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Occupational Therapist Video skill.

- Generates scripts and b-roll suggestions for patient and referral source videos for occupational therapy practices.
- Supports various video types: practice overviews, specific condition focus, therapy approaches, sensory gym showcases, parent education, and referral source explanations.
- Customizes videos based on practice specializations, therapy settings, assessment tools, and family or caregiver involvement approaches.
- Designed to help OTs clearly communicate their treatment philosophy, assessment approach, and real-life functional outcomes to families and referrals.
